records.title: Renewable Energy Initiatives by Coal PSUs
details: a to b: CIL has installed about 247 MW of renewable energy, and around 635 MW is under development. NLCIL has installed 1,783 MW and has 1,762 MW under construction. SCCL has installed 245.50 MW, and around 259 MW is under development.

records.title: Status of Road Projects in Delhi
details:
(a) to (d) (i) For de-congestion of Delhi, especially the Dhaula Kuan- Indira Gandhi International (IGI) Airport-Gurugram section of NH-48, the
work of preparation of Detailed Project Report (DPR) has been taken
up for the construction of tunnel connecting Shiv Murti (Mahipalpur) to
Nelson Mandela Marg in Delhi. It would be connected with NH-48 and Dwarka Expressway through an interchange.
(ii) (e) Delhi–Dehradun Expressway (National Highway 709B) is under
implementation stage and same is targeted for its completion by
October 2025.

records.title: Quality Education Infrastructure in Delhi
details: c: A Navodaya Vidalaya has been sanctioned in Norther East Delhi District. Due to the unavailability of suitable land and temporary accommodation in Shahdara and North East Delhi districts, permission has been granted to open two additional NVs on the available space within the campus of the existing NV Mungeshpur, North West Delhi.
